_about: Thomas Bulfinch (1796-1867): the three books later bound as Bulfinch's Mythology — The Age of Fable (1855), The Age of Chivalry (1858), Legends of Charlemagne (1863) — held as three works, plus his Oregon and Eldorado (1866). Clean Gutenberg text; US public domain.

bulfinch-age-of-fable: The Age of Fable, or Stories of Gods and Heroes (1855)
bulfinch-age-of-chivalry: The Age of Chivalry, or Legends of King Arthur (1858)
bulfinch-legends-of-charlemagne: Legends of Charlemagne, or Romance of the Middle Ages (1863)
bulfinch-oregon-and-eldorado: Oregon and Eldorado; or, Romance of the Rivers (1866)

_excluded.bulfinch-combined: Bulfinch's Mythology in one file (PG 4928, 56644) and a second Age of Fable (PG 3327): the three books are held singly
_excluded.bulfinch-gayley: The Classic Myths in English Literature (PG 46063): Charles Mills Gayley's book based on Bulfinch, not Bulfinch's text
_excluded.bulfinch-pending: PENDING: Poetry of the Age of Fable (1863), Shakespeare Adapted for Reading Classes (1865), The Boy Inventor (1860) — Internet Archive scans not yet checked
